name: Biology
description: Cell biology, molecular genetics, cellular respiration, meiosis, and evolutionary mechanisms.

topics.name: Cellular Respiration & ATP
topics.description: Glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport chain

questions.prompt: In eukaryotic cells, which organelle is the primary site of oxidative phosphorylation and aerobic ATP production?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate the vast majority of cellular ATP via the electron transport chain on the inner mitochondrial membrane.

questions.prompt: During transcription in eukaryotic protein synthesis, which enzyme synthesizes mRNA from the DNA template strand?
questions.explanation: RNA Polymerase II reads the template DNA strand in the 3’ to 5’ direction to synthesize pre-mRNA.
